data.raw_text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

09 APRIL 2026

TRAFFIC ALERT: CLOSURE OF KATHERINE STREET AT GRAYSTON DRIVE OVERPASS DUE TO CRIME SCENE

The Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) wishes to inform motorists of a major traffic disruption in Sandton. Katherine Street is currently closed to all traffic beneath the Grayston Drive overpass following a shooting incident earlier this afternoon.

The area has been cordoned off to allow the South African Police Service (SAPS) and relevant authorities to process the crime scene. There is a significant police presence on-site.

As we approach the afternoon peak hours, this closure is likely to cause severe delays on all surrounding routes, including:

* Katherine Street (Northbound and Southbound)

* Grayston Drive

* M1 Highway (Off-ramps at Grayston Drive)

* West Street and Rivonia Road

JMPD officers are being deployed to assist with traffic control and to divert vehicles away from the scene. Motorists are advised to exercise patience and follow officers’ instructions on the ground.

To avoid congestion, motorists should consider using the following alternative routes:

1. Marlboro Drive
2. Sandton Drive
3. Rivonia Road
4. South Road

The closure will remain until the crime scene has been cleared. Further updates will be provided once the roadway is reopened.

Issued by the Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) Communications Unit #SaferJoburg #JoburgRoadSafety #JHBTraffic

TRAFFIC ADVISORY
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

09 April 2026

EMERGENCY ROAD CLOSURE ON CROWNWOOD ROAD IN ORMONDE DUE TO A CRIME SCENE

The Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) wishes to inform motorists of a complete road closure currently in effect at the intersection of Crownwood Road and Rente Street in Ormonde.

This closure is due to an active crime scene. Law enforcement officials are presently on-site processing the area. For public safety and to preserve the integrity of the scene, the roadway will remain inaccessible until further notice.

Motorists should expect heavy delays on all routes approaching the Ormonde area, particularly the M1 Highway.

Crownwood Road is cordoned off between Rente Street and the surrounding blocks.

Traffic is being diverted by officers on the ground; however, secondary routes are already experiencing high volumes.

Motorists are strongly advised to seek alternative routes to reach their destinations.

They can use Xavier Street or the M1 Highway (Booysens/Gold Reef City exits) to bypass the affected intersection.

END

Issued by the Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) Communications Unit #SaferJoburg #JoburgRoadSafety #JHBTraffic
data.cleaned_text: TRAFFIC ADVISORY FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE 09 April 2026 EMERGENCY ROAD CLOSURE ON CROWNWOOD ROAD IN ORMONDE DUE TO A CRIME SCENE The Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) wishes to inform motorists of a complete road closure currently in effect at the intersection of Crownwood Road and Rente Street in Ormonde. This closure is due to an active crime scene. Law enforcement officials are presently on-site processing the area. For public safety and to preserve the integrity of the scene, the roadway will remain inaccessible until further notice. Motorists should expect heavy delays on all routes approaching the Ormonde area, particularly the M1 Highway. Crownwood Road is cordoned off between Rente Street and the surrounding blocks. Traffic is being diverted by officers on the ground; however, secondary routes are already experiencing high volumes. Motorists are strongly advised to seek alternative routes to reach their destinations. They can use Xavier Street or the M1 Highway (Booysens/Gold Reef City exits) to bypass the affected intersection. END Issued by the Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) Communications Unit #SaferJoburg #JoburgRoadSafety #JHBTraffic
